name: Apostasy
overview: Scripture reveals apostasy as the deliberate forsaking of the LORD, often influenced by close relationships or enticing false teachings, as seen when loved ones urge turning to other gods (Deuteronomy 13:6, 13). This spiritual rebellion is marked by complacency and pride, leading to a rejection of God who is the Rock of salvation (Deuteronomy 32:15). The consequences are severe, with transgressors and those who abandon the LORD facing destruction and divine judgment (Isaiah 1:28; Jeremiah 17:5). Additionally, apostasy involves forgetting God's holiness and turning to idolatry, which provokes His wrath (Isaiah 65:11).
